旧军工厂的自动线仍在运转，尸潮把废料管廊变成巢穴。夺回厂区，才能恢复重炮弹药补给: The abandoned arms factory has become a horde nest. Retake it to restore heavy-ammunition supplies.

压制毒雾扩散，摧毁生化舱深处的母巢。: Contain the toxic mist and destroy the broodmother.

穿越高压廊道，击破守在主变压器前的大首领。: Cross the high-voltage corridors and defeat the boss at the transformer.

关闭虚空裂隙，击破圣堂深处的异化守卫。: Seal the Void rift and defeat the warped guardian.
坠毁的轨道设施压在城市边缘，残骸中仍有自动防御与感染信号。向上推进才能发现终局核: The collapsed orbital facility still broadcasts infected signals. Push through the wreckage toward the Apex Core.
穿过轨道残骸，夺回通往核心区的升降通路。: Cross the orbital wreckage and retake the core-sector lift.
尸潮的主控核心埋在能源塔底部，所有变异信号都在这里汇聚。最后一条防线必须向核心反: Every mutation signal converges beneath the energy tower. Push the final defense toward the command core.
击穿核心外壳，在最终战中终结尸潮指挥源。: Breach the core shell and destroy the horde's command source.
尸潮提速，留出控制窗口: Faster hordes leave narrower control windows
优先减速、冰霜与多重火力，先处理贴近防线的疾行单位。: Prioritize Slow, Frost, and Multishot. Eliminate fast units closest to the defense line first.
重装单位更耐打，突破更痛: Armored units are tougher and breaches hurt more
优先穿透、蓄能与元素克制，锁定重甲单位集中破防。: Prioritize Piercing, Charged attacks, and elemental counters. Lock armored units and focus-fire their defenses.
死亡爆裂威胁防线: Death bursts threaten the defense line
在中远距离完成击杀，避免让爆裂单位贴近防线后连锁引爆。: Secure kills at medium or long range. Do not let explosive units reach the line and trigger chain detonations.
用火焰与爆发快速打断控场源，保留角色技能应对密集波次。: Use Fire and burst damage to interrupt control sources quickly. Save the hero active for dense waves.
优先清除支援与连锁单位，利用毒素克制和追踪火力减少漏怪。: Eliminate support and chain units first. Use Toxin counters and Homing fire to prevent breaches.
持续压制与突破并行: Sustained pressure and breaches occur together
先清召唤和再生源，使用火焰克制，避免战线被持续消耗。: Clear summoners and regeneration sources first. Use Fire counters to stop continuous attrition.
光环与召唤更活跃: Auras and summons are more active
手动锁定支援单位，优先使用追踪、连锁和范围火力拆掉增益网络。: Manually lock support units. Use Homing, Chain, and area fire to dismantle their buff network.
突进单位更快更频繁: Rush units are faster and appear more often
使用追踪、闪电与减速覆盖突进路线，角色技能留给相位集群。: Cover rush lanes with Homing, Lightning, and Slow. Save the hero active for phase clusters.
按首领弱点配装，保留爆发技能跨过阶段阈值，优先处理随从。: Build around the boss weakness. Save burst skills to cross phase thresholds and eliminate adds first.
速度、机制与突破全面升级: Speed, mechanics, and breach pressure are all upgraded
形成一套主伤害流派并补一张控制或防线牌，手动锁定最高威胁。: Complete one primary damage build, add a control or defense card, and manually lock the highest threat.
连续命中击破装甲，破甲后立刻用火焰与主动技能集火。: Break the armor with repeated hits, then immediately focus Fire damage and your active skill.
冰霜克制熔火，保留控制与爆发跨过狂暴阈值。: Use Frost against molten attacks. Save control and burst damage to cross the enrage threshold.

毒素可克制雷暴本体，先清支援单位以切断连锁增幅。: Toxin counters the storm core. Eliminate support units first to break its chain amplification.
火焰优先烧掉召唤物，手动锁定母体阻止尸群滚雪球。: Burn down summons first, then manually lock the broodmother before the horde can snowball.
用闪电和追踪覆盖相位路线，主动技能留给连续突进。: Cover phase routes with Lightning and Homing. Save the active skill for consecutive rushes.
用火焰压制再生，阶段转换后立即爆发，避免血线回升。: Use Fire to suppress regeneration, then burst immediately after each phase transition.
使用物理破防主轴，并搭配控制或屏障穿过复合机制阶段。: Build around Physical armor break, then add control or Barrier to survive the compound-mechanic phases.
